Cybersecurity Assessment Authorization & Waiver

AUTHORIZATION. By completing this waiver, the undersigned authorized representative grants Lotus Cybersecurity LLC express written authorization to conduct cybersecurity assessment activities on the systems, networks, and digital infrastructure defined in the agreed scope.

SCOPE. Unless agreed otherwise in writing, this authorization covers internal network assessment only. Testing is limited to systems and IP ranges explicitly listed as in-scope. External testing requires separate written authorization.

RISK ACKNOWLEDGMENT. Client acknowledges that active network testing may cause temporary disruption to services or network performance. Lotus Cybersecurity will take reasonable precautions to minimize impact but cannot guarantee zero disruption.

LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. Lotus Cybersecurity shall not be held liable for system disruptions or service interruptions arising from authorized testing activities, except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct. Client confirms critical systems are backed up prior to testing.

LEGAL AUTHORITY. Client warrants that the signatory has full legal authority to authorize cybersecurity testing of all listed systems. Client assumes all liability for ensuring proper authorization for any third-party or co-located systems.

CONFIDENTIALITY. Lotus Cybersecurity maintains strict confidentiality of all findings, client data, and engagement details. Reports are delivered exclusively to authorized Client representatives and not disclosed to third parties without written consent.

ACCEPTANCE. Submission of this signed waiver constitutes a legally binding agreement. This document is retained as part of the formal engagement record.

I am an authorized representative with full legal authority to authorize cybersecurity testing on behalf of the named organization.
I authorize Lotus Cybersecurity LLC to conduct the assessment as defined in the agreed scope, including active testing of network and security controls.
I understand testing may cause temporary service disruption and accept this risk as part of the engagement.
I acknowledge there is no guarantee of zero impact and confirm that critical systems have been backed up prior to this engagement.
I confirm all in-scope systems are properly authorized — no unauthorized third-party or co-located systems are included without separate written consent.
I have read and agree to all terms of this authorization waiver, including limitation of liability and confidentiality provisions.
